finding: Checks return a worker pathname; a concurrent writer with bundle write authority could replace it before exec.
disposition: Retained limitation, outside the untrusted project/model admission boundary; not treated as a fixed race.
basis: Every package entry is owner/root-controlled and cannot be group/other writable.
Such a writer also controls the host executable; this app is not a same-user code containment boundary.
The app does not update its installed bundle in place. Bundle construction refuses existing destinations and publishes by rename.
This change checks content pins, valid signatures, signer when present and resource seal at admission. It does not claim atomic verified-file execution.
other_findings: Reviewer found no compiled-pin, signer, marker downgrade or build/no-build defect.
